description: A LightningJS component named 'WeatherNow' that displays current weather conditions including temperature, icon, description, feels-like temperature, humidity, and wind information. It reacts to store state, supports focus and transition effects, and navigates to the forecast page on 'enter'.

classes.name: WeatherNow
classes.description: LightningJS component that renders current weather information and handles user interactions.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets the component to focused state, highlighting it visually.

methods.name: unfocus
methods.description: Clears the focused state, removing visual focus indication.
